name: Each analysis paragraph is at least 200 characters long
description: Analysis paragraphs should be substantive. Each visible paragraph in the analysis panel should contain at least 200 characters of text to ensure meaningful content rather than one-liners.

planSteps.description: Click on a match bracket cell to open a match detail page
Click the Analysis tab to reveal the analysis panel
Scroll through the analysis panel to see all paragraphs
Verify that the first visible analysis paragraph contains at least 200 characters of text. The paragraph should be a full sentence or more, not a short stub.
